note: Figma variable name -> published CSS key. AUTHORED, not generated: the exporter reads this, and must never derive it from existing output. Reasoning, coverage and the killed keys are in design-system/docs/13-rename-map.md. Scope: COLOR variables of Semantic and Component. Numerics and text styles are NOT covered yet — see the doc.

semantic.rule: first matching prefix wins; the remainder is slugged ('/' -> '-') and appended
notes: motion/* added 2026-08-19. It is the only non-colour family covered here on purpose: 5 FLOAT durations (ms) and 4 STRING easing curves, all authored with codeSyntax already set, so the map and Dev Mode agree by construction. The prefix goes FIRST because it must not fall through to a colour rule.

color/shadow/ added 2026-08-19 for the elevation scale. color/surface/elevation/* needs NO new rule: the existing color/surface/ -> --surface- prefix already yields --surface-elevation-raised and friends. Verified against the codeSyntax authored on each variable, not assumed.

killed.reason: Every one encodes a fixed account slot (ARQ / Toptal / Bancolombia / other) from before Alfredo decided the account colour is chosen by the user. There is no Figma source for any of them; --account-2-surface has no matching value anywhere in the file. Publishing them again would re-publish a dead model under names that mean nothing.
killed.precondition: build.py MAP lines 109-112 and two src/ call sites migrate first — see docs/inbox/dev/A-2026-08-17-rename-map.md. Slot 4 is byte-identical to color/account/*, so --color-account-other-{bg,txt} -> --account-{surface,foreground} is a pixel-preserving rename.

not_covered_yet: Numeric variables (the `num` block, 108 keys, now 108 + the 5 motion durations, which ARE covered - see the `motion` block). Component numerics look like the same slug rule (avatar/size/sm -> --avatar-size-sm) but this has NOT been verified key by key. Do not assume it.
Text styles (the `text` block, 26 rows). Different shape entirely: name|weight|size|lineHeight|letterSpacing.
Primitives and Typography collections are not published and need no map.

moved.reason: badge/primary/* never belonged to Badge. Measured 2026-08-18: 28 paint bindings in the Figma file, all of them action-chip (State=Selected fill + border), and Badge binds it zero times. Dev's 'published, no consumer' was about src/; both readings are true and together they settle it. Renamed IN PLACE in Figma so every binding followed its variable id — no rebinding, no risk of a stale paint.
moved.expect_in_next_dump: 3 REMOVED (--badge-primary-*) + 3 ADDED (--action-chip-selected-*). Not drift. No consumer in src/, so nothing has to migrate first.
moved.also_fixed: action-chip's selected label and icon were bound to notification/primary/background - a background token doing a foreground's job, borrowed from a third component. Rebound to action-chip/selected/foreground. Light is byte-identical (#0e7490 both ways); dark goes #06b6d4 -> #22d3ee, which takes the label from 4.23:1 to 5.68:1 over the composited chip fill. The AA failure was real and is gone.

motion.types: the five durations are FLOAT in milliseconds; the four curves are STRING and ship verbatim (a cubic-bezier(...) or 'linear'). build.py has to emit the durations with a 'ms' unit - a bare number is not a valid CSS duration.
motion.expect_in_next_dump: 9 ADDED. Nothing removed, nothing changed. No consumer in src/ yet: the 28 hand-written duration-* classes migrate afterwards, one by one, and that is a src/ change.

effect_styles.problem: These are EFFECT STYLES, not variables. figma-dump.js only walks variables, so the exporter cannot see them at all and build.py has no block to emit them. This is the same shape as the `text` block for text styles: a separate kind, a separate dump, a separate emitter.
effect_styles.shape: Each style is two DROP_SHADOWs. Layer order is ambient then key. Colours are variable-bound (--shadow-key, --shadow-ambient) so they follow the mode; the geometry is fixed inside the style.
effect_styles.expect_in_next_dump: 6 ADDED variables (--shadow-key, --shadow-ambient, --surface-elevation-{raised,menu,floating,overlay}). The four effect styles will NOT appear until the exporter grows a block for them.
